title: LumiGrid Channel Group Schema
description: Schema for grouping multiple LED/PWM/display channels as logical subgroups in the sequencer

id.description: Unique identifier for the channel group

name.description: Human-readable name for the channel group

description.description: Optional description of the channel group

channels.description: List of channel identifiers included in this group

enabled.description: Whether the channel group is currently active

collapsed.description: Whether the group is collapsed in the UI (for display purposes)

color.description: Color identifier for visual distinction in UI
